differential_acceptance.identity_unit: stable external point ID, never cross-version physical offset
differential_acceptance.posting_membership: exact external-ID set when the same verified router and assignment are used
differential_acceptance.candidate_membership: exact external-ID set for the same buckets and posting generation
differential_acceptance.ranking: ordered by native score with exact-score boundary ties recorded explicitly
differential_acceptance.scores: finite native Float32 results; any tolerance must be derived from measured scorer reduction differences
differential_acceptance.official_recall: unchanged original SISAP23 ID-overlap metric, separate from native exactness
differential_acceptance.mutation: applied insert/upsert/delete must respect authoritative Qdrant visibility and unique external IDs
differential_acceptance.fallback: every tested learned or Plain path must be explicitly attributed
differential_acceptance.reopen: clean restart retains logical IDs, visibility, config and trained route when supported

known_gate_blockers: Historical 300K LMI metadata is version 2, while both committed v1.19 mainline and v1.20 port require version 3; direct reuse is not yet validated.
The historical 300K result was produced by an older source/protocol, so it is a reference, not a same-source v1.19 comparator.
The repository's full OpenAPI generator requires Docker; Docker is unavailable in this WSL distro.
